pages.markdown: HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol. Linux was originally authored by Linus Torvalds. Python 3.0 was released in 2008. CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets. The default port for HTTPS is 443. This HandoffKit JavaScript workspace uses pnpm.

The capital of France is Paris. The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean by area. The longest river in Africa is the Nile. Kenya is on the continent of Africa. The capital of Japan is Tokyo. The Atacama Desert is in Chile.

The chemical symbol for water is H2O. The IAU currently recognizes 8 planets in the Solar System. The electron carries a negative electric charge in an atom. The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 299792458 m/s. Plants absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis. The SI unit of electric current is the ampere.

The United States federal government has 3 branches. The United Nations was founded in 1945. The United States Constitution begins with We the People. A United States senator serves a term of 6 years. The elected body of the UK Parliament is the House of Commons. The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for Spain is ES.

William Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet. The Prado Museum is in Madrid. Badminton uses a shuttlecock. A common acoustic piano has 88 keys. One Hundred Years of Solitude was originally written in Spanish.
